{'text': '加州沙加緬度（美聯社）——特朗普政府週四起訴加州選舉官員，要求法官禁止該州在下月中期選舉中計算聯邦政府認定為「可能」非公民人士所投的郵寄選票，直至當局能夠確認其移民身份。', 'paragraph_context': 'SACRAMENTO, Calif. (AP) — The Trump administration sued California election officials Thursday, asking a judge to bar the state from counting mail-in ballots for next month’s midterm elections from people the federal government has identified as “likely” noncitizens until their immigration status can be confirmed.'}

{'text': '這宗訴訟是由司法部聲稱加州官員未能在48小時限期內審查一個載有2萬個名字的密碼保護USB隨身碟後提出。聯邦政府表示，這些人可能是非公民，並已獲發選票參與11月3日的選舉，但州務卿指政府並無提供證據支持此說法。該州向所有已登記選民郵寄選票。', 'paragraph_context': 'The lawsuit comes after the Justice Department said California officials failed to meet a 48-hour deadline to review a password-protected thumb drive that contains a list of 20,000 names. The federal government says those are likely noncitizens who were sent ballots to participate in the Nov. 3 election, although the secretary of state said the administration has provided no evidence to support that claim. The state mails ballots to all registered voters.'}

{'text': '這宗訴訟起訴是繼司法部一名高層官員本週較早時發出信件，威脅若加州不合作將採取法律行動之後而提出。', 'paragraph_context': 'The lawsuit follows a letter sent earlier this week by a top Justice Department official who threatened potential legal action if California didn’t comply.'}

{'text': '聯邦政府未有指明這2萬名選民集中於哪些地區，不過該名單於週二直接送交洛杉磯縣選舉事務處處長Dean Logan，其辦公室在聲明中確認此事。Logan亦被列為訴訟被告。', 'paragraph_context': 'The federal government didn’t specify where the 20,000 voters were concentrated, but the list was sent directly to Los Angeles County Registrar Dean Logan on Tuesday, his office confirmed in a statement. Logan is also named as a defendant in the lawsuit.'}

{'text': '根據州務卿辦公室的數據，該縣約有600萬名選民，其中約半數登記為民主黨人。全州登記選民超過2,300萬，加州其他選區亦有數個競爭激烈的國會席位，可能決定哪個黨派能夠控制美國眾議院至特朗普總統任期最後兩年。', 'paragraph_context': 'The county has roughly 6 million voters, roughly half of whom are registered Democrats, according to the secretary of state’s office. Over 23 million people are registered statewide, and there are a handful of competitive congressional races in other California districts that could determine which party has control of the U.S. House for the final two years of President Donald Trump’s term.'}

{'text': '專家指訴訟或為失實選舉指控鋪路', 'paragraph_context': 'Expert Says Lawsuit Could Set Stage For False Election Claims'}

{'text': '加州州務卿Shirley Weber在致司法部的信函中表示，聯邦政府並無提供證據，支持其指加州選民名冊上2萬個名字為非公民的說法。她提及一宗先例，聯邦政府最初指內華達州選民名冊上有近1.6萬名可能非公民，但該州查明所有被標示的人士實際上均為美國公民。', 'paragraph_context': 'California Secretary of State Shirley Weber said in a letter to the Justice Department that the federal government hasn’t provided evidence to support its allegation that 20,000 names on the state’s voter rolls are of noncitizens. She referenced an instance in which the federal government initially alleged nearly 16,000 possible noncitizens were listed on Nevada’s voter rolls, but the state determined that all the people flagged were, in fact, U.S. citizens.'}

{'text': '她亦指出，州內投票已經展開。Weber是民主黨人，她表示司法部正「要求採取前所未見的措施，威脅數千名加州人的投票權，所依據的是你們至今仍未能解釋或提供的不可核實資料或方法」。', 'paragraph_context': 'She also noted that voting is already underway in the state. Weber, a Democrat, said the Justice Department was “demanding unprecedented measures that threaten thousands of Californians’ right to vote, based on unverifiable information or methodology that you still fail to explain or provide.”'}

{'text': '她補充指，加州選舉完全符合聯邦法律。', 'paragraph_context': 'California’s elections are in “full compliance” with federal law, she added.'}

{'text': '選舉法專家、選舉創新與研究中心主管David Becker稱司法部的訴訟「相當無聊」。', 'paragraph_context': 'David Becker, an election law expert who heads the Center for Election Innovation and Research, called the Justice Department’s lawsuit “fairly frivolous.”'}

{'text': 'Becker表示：「如果他們真的想以良好合作態度去清理他們認為有問題的選民名單，他們幾個月前就應該以截然不同的方式這樣做。然而，這確實令人質疑，此舉是否純粹是為日後對選舉作出失實指控而鋪路。」', 'paragraph_context': '“If they were seeking to work in good faith to clean up the voter list that they believed had issues, they would have done this months ago in a much different fashion,” Becker said. “However, it does raise questions as to whether or not the sole purpose of this is to set the stage for false claims about elections.”'}

{'text': '懷疑非法選民名單以USB隨身碟送交', 'paragraph_context': 'List Of Alleged Illegal Voters Delivered On A Thumb Drive'}

{'text': 'Logan表示，其辦公室收到的USB隨身碟附有一張「手寫字條，提供密碼」以存取選民名冊上懷疑非公民的名單。他指他不認為該USB隨身碟屬於安全裝置。州務卿辦公室指密碼是「寫在便利貼上」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Logan said his office received the thumb drive along with a “hand written note providing a password” to access the list of alleged noncitizens on the voter rolls. He said he did not consider the thumb drive a secure device. The secretary of state’s office said the password was written “on a sticky note.”'}

{'text': 'Becker表示，大多數選舉官員的網絡安全守則都不允許他們按司法部送交的方式配合其要求。', 'paragraph_context': 'Becker said most election officials’ cybersecurity protocols would not allow them to comply with the Justice Department’s request as it was sent.'}

{'text': '他說：「選舉辦事處不會隨便把USB隨身碟插入其系統，原因是顯而易見的。」', 'paragraph_context': '“Election offices do not just stick thumb drives into their technology, for very good reason,” he said.'}

{'text': '司法部的訴訟指，聯邦政府曾尋求與加州合作」找出登記投票的非公民，但「加州並無作出任何認真努力」。', 'paragraph_context': 'The Justice Department’s lawsuit says the federal government sought to “work collaboratively” with California to identify noncitizens registered to vote in the state, and “California made no serious effort to do so.”'}

{'text': '訴訟指出：「因此，當選票受到質疑時，美國尋求的是常見的選舉濟助。」訴訟又指：「本庭應禁止加州在即將舉行的聯邦選舉中，目前點算可能為非公民的郵寄選票，直至有關選民的公民身份得以確定。」', 'paragraph_context': '“The United States thus seeks commonplace election relief when a ballot is called into question,” the lawsuit says. “This Court should enjoin California from presently tabulating vote by-mail ballots from likely noncitizens in the upcoming federal election until the voter’s citizenship status can be determined,” the lawsuit says.'}

{'text': '被列為訴訟被告之一的Weber表示，聯邦政府這次的接觸算不上合作。', 'paragraph_context': 'Weber, who is named in the lawsuit, suggested the federal government’s outreach had not been collaborative.'}

{'text': '她說，今年夏季，國土安全部聲稱加州選民名冊上有19萬名非公民，但當州務卿辦公室要求提供相關方法和數據來源時，對方拒絕提供。', 'paragraph_context': 'She said that over the summer, the Department of Homeland Security claimed that California had 190,000 noncitizens on its voter rolls but refused to provide the methodology or data sources when the office asked for them.'}

{'text': '她在週四的信中稱司法部近日的要求是「司法部自製的緊急情況」。', 'paragraph_context': 'In her letter Thursday, she called the recent demands “an emergency of the DOJ’s creation.”'}

{'text': '選舉前數週發出信函', 'paragraph_context': 'Letters Sent Weeks Before Elections'}

{'text': '代理副司法部長Trent McCotter發出的信函給予該州時間，研究其聲稱可能並非公民的2萬人名單只有48小時。對於那些公民身份無法被獨立核實的人士，州政府須指示地方選舉官員將其郵寄選票分開處理，直至其移民身份得以確定，並且不得向任何尚未收到選票的人士發出選票。', 'paragraph_context': 'The letter sent by acting Deputy Attorney General Trent McCotter gave the state 48 hours to research the list of the 20,000 people it claims might not be citizens. For those whose citizenship cannot be independently verified, the state is to instruct local election officials to segregate their mail-in ballots until their immigration status can be determined, and to not provide a ballot to anyone who has not yet received one.'}

{'text': '加州司法部長Rob Bonta於週四早上出席一個不相關的記者會時表示，州官員不會執行聯邦政府扣起涉嫌非公民選民選票的要求。他指出，政府聲稱加州選民名冊上的非公民人數，由國土安全部夏季標示的19萬人，下降至司法部所指的2萬人。', 'paragraph_context': 'California Attorney General Rob Bonta said at an unrelated press conference Thursday morning that state officials would not carry out the federal government’s requests to withhold ballots for the alleged noncitizen voters. He noted that the administration’s alleged number of noncitizens on the state’s voter rolls had dropped from the 190,000 flagged over the summer by the Department of Homeland Security to the 20,000 noted by the Justice Department.'}

{'text': 'Bonta說：「那另外17萬人怎麼了？他們只是弄錯了。」', 'paragraph_context': '“What happened to those 170,000? They just got those wrong,” Bonta said.'}

{'text': '他又指，特朗普政府正違反一項聯邦法律，該法律禁止各州在選舉前90天內更改選民名冊。', 'paragraph_context': 'He also said the Trump administration was violating a federal law that prohibits states from changing voter rolls within 90 days of an election.'}

{'text': '他說：「他們正處於前所未有的、無理、無法無天的境地。」', 'paragraph_context': '“They are in unprecedented, baseless, lawless territory,” he said.'}

{'text': '特朗普政府今年將打擊非公民選民列為重點工作，儘管這種情況極為罕見。司法部今年至今已就各類選舉不當行為起訴約90人，其中50人被指以非公民身份投票。2024年總統選舉期間，全美登記選民超過2.27億。', 'paragraph_context': 'The Trump administration has made the hunt for noncitizen voters a priority this year, even though the problem is exceptionally rare. The Justice Department has charged about 90 people for various types of election misconduct so far this year, including 50 who are alleged to have voted as noncitizens. There were more than 227 million registered voters in the United States during the 2024 presidential election.'}

{'text': '加州中區聯邦檢察官首席助理Bill Essayli為司法部起訴加州的行動作出辯護。', 'paragraph_context': 'Bill Essayli, the first assistant U.S. attorney for the Central District of California, defended the Justice Department’s move to take California to court.'}

{'text': '他在X上發文寫道：「這不是政治操作，亦無爭議。我們不會容許加州稀釋美國公民的選票。」', 'paragraph_context': '“This is not political or controversial,” he wrote in a post on X. “We will not allow California to dilute the votes of American citizens.”'}

{'text': 'Austin於沙加緬度、Riddle於洛杉磯、Durkin Richer於華盛頓報道。美聯社記者Ali Swenson於紐約亦有貢獻。', 'paragraph_context': 'Austin reported from Sacramento, Riddle from Los Angeles and Durkin Richer from Washington. Associated Press writer Ali Swenson in New York contributed.'}
